newsitem.title: USA: Southern parent to be bought by MC Equities.
newsitem.headline: Southern parent to be bought by MC Equities.

text.p: Southern Security Life Insurance Co said on Friday that its parent company, Consolidare Enterprises Inc, has agreed to be acquired by MC Equities Inc for $13.5 million.
Both Consolidare and MC Equities are privately held. Consolidare owns 57.4 percent of Southern Security, the company said in a news release.
If approved by Consolidare shareholders and Florida insurance regulators, the transaction should close within six months, Southern said.
MC Equities, based in New York, is the parent of Mid-western National Life Insurance of Ohio.
